changelog: - **Programme template catalogue** (#1641). `src/lib/programTemplates.ts` ships five ready-made programme shapes — the canonical thirteen-stage pipeline plus a graduate internship, an onboarding buddy programme, a leadership cohort and a career transition — each with its own ordered stage set, its own per-stage service levels, its own reminder cadence and, where it matters, the documents the programme expects. Stage keys are stable identifiers in code (prefixed per template so two templates never collide, and none of them naming a canonical default key, which `check:stage-keys` forbids); every stage label ships in EN/TR/DE in the module, and the template names and descriptions live in the new `programTemplates` dictionary block, so `check:i18n` enforces the parity. The module is deliberately Prisma-free and client-safe, so the launch wizard (#1643) can render the catalogue with no server round-trip. Nothing applies a template automatically: `templateStagePayload()` produces the exact body the EXISTING editor endpoint `PUT /api/admin/organizations/[id]/pipeline-stages` already accepts, so a template inherits that route's authz, premium gate and validation rather than getting a second writer — and because that endpoint replaces the stage set with deleteMany + createMany and remaps no relation (#1634), `templateApplyBlockers()` refuses outright when any mentee sits on a stage the template does not contain, and requires an explicit confirmation before replacing a stage set an organization has already customised. `validateProgramTemplate()` guards key syntax and length, the 50-stage ceiling, unique stage keys and orders, exactly one first on-path stage, a reachable terminal stage, SLAs naming stages that exist and three-locale label parity; a new `e2e/program-templates.unit.spec.ts` runs it over the whole catalogue in the smoke gate, so a malformed template is a red build rather than a 400 at apply time. `e2e/program-template-apply.spec.ts` applies a template to a fresh organization through the editor endpoint and asserts the resulting stage set, order, labels and flags. Catalogue only — no schema change, no new table and no user-visible surface yet.

en: Ready-made programme shapes are now part of the product: a graduate internship, an onboarding buddy programme, a leadership cohort, a career transition, and the classic internship pipeline — each with its own stages, deadlines and reminder rhythm, in English, Turkish and German. The screen that lets you pick one arrives next.
tr: Hazır program şekilleri artık üründe: mezun stajı, işe alıştırma (buddy) programı, liderlik kohortu, kariyer geçişi ve klasik staj hattı — her biri kendi aşamaları, süreleri ve hatırlatma temposuyla, İngilizce, Türkçe ve Almanca olarak. Bunlardan birini seçtiğiniz ekran bir sonraki adımda geliyor.
de: Fertige Programmformen gehören jetzt zum Produkt: Absolventenpraktikum, Onboarding-Buddy-Programm, Führungskräfte-Kohorte, berufliche Neuorientierung und die klassische Praktikums-Pipeline — jeweils mit eigenen Stufen, Fristen und Erinnerungsrhythmen, auf Deutsch, Englisch und Türkisch. Die Oberfläche zur Auswahl folgt als Nächstes.
